tools.name: latest_board
tools.description: FREE. The whole current board: every coin row named in the latest videos of the tracked crypto YouTube channels, with the stance, the call and the dated specifics. Free. Upstream briefs land on about 71% of days; board content is same-day roughly half the time and is never more than three days old.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
